The '''BAF-379 Industrial Droid''' was an [[Industrial droid/Legends|industrial droid]] model that was produced by [[Balmorran Arms/Legends|Balmorran Arms]] at the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. BAF-379 Industrial Droids were used in the factory near the end of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
